rationale: On the old TypeScript path, t1 resolved the unknown root model to null, set v2Preferred only from multiAgentVersion === v2, and therefore called removeAgentsMaxThreads with the non-V2 rule that removes only the literal 1000. The user agents.max_threads = 6 remained, unlike the migration guard, so t1 was necessarily RED. The fix extends only the V2-active decision with the existing enabled=true table condition; model heuristics, V2 enable/disable behavior, and managed/user cap handling remain unchanged. The migration guard received one cross-reference comment and the TypeScript rule received the reciprocal comment to prevent future mirror drift. Local bun test, vitest, and node --test were not run per task hard rule; the requested CI-parity checks and direct runtime exercise were run instead.
